changelog: EXPLOSIONS. Ordnance now detonates on every tile it catches, all at once — a rocket's splash lands as one blast across its whole area, and the damage follows the shell instead of punching through it. Tiles you cannot see stay dark. BOSSES TALK: every commander opens with a line before its first move, reacts as you wound it, and remarks when you kill something it commands; their bark pools nearly tripled, so a long fight no longer loops the same three lines, and each boss's dialogue leans on the mechanic that beats it. A NEW WARLORD CARD FRAME — a trench parapet of sandbags, wire and spent brass, across all 18 Warlord cards. And you can BROWSE CARDS without closing them: in the Collection, the deck, or any pile, a zoomed card has arrows either side, responds to a swipe, and steps with the arrow keys.
